patch:
diff --git a/solution.sh b/solution.sh
index 4af2940..3c6427c 100644
--- a/solution.sh
+++ b/solution.sh
@@ -1,7 +1,11 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
-# Join the arguments together with commas.
+# Join the arguments together with commas, preserving each argument intact.
 result=""
-for arg in $@; do
-  result="$result,$arg"
+for arg in "$@"; do
+  if [ -z "$result" ]; then
+    result="$arg"
+  else
+    result="$result,$arg"
+  fi
 done
-echo "${result#,}"
+echo "$result"
prompt: The script solution.sh joins its command-line arguments together separated by commas. It works when the arguments are single words, but arguments that contain spaces get split apart — for example `bash solution.sh "a b" c` should print "a b,c" but instead prints "a,b,c". Fix it so each argument is treated as a single unit, spaces and all. A single argument should print unchanged with no comma.
